extracted.intended_audience: prospective applicants to the DOE Computational Science Graduate Fellowship (CSGF); students planning Ph.D. study
extracted.subtask_description: Eligibility and program requirement rules for applicants and fellows in the DOE Computational Science Graduate Fellowship (CSGF) program, covering who may apply, enrollment/participation obligations, renewal criteria, and allowable outside support. Intended to guide prospective applicants and current fellows.

rubrics_metrics.name: Citizenship / Residency
rubrics_metrics.description: The DOE CSGF is open to U.S. citizens or lawful permanent residents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligibility is measured at the time of application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Intent to pursue full-time, uninterrupted Ph.D. study
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants must plan full-time, uninterrupted study toward a Ph.D. at an accredited U.S. university.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The fellowship provides four years of support but must be renewed annually; fellows are required to be enrolled full-time during the fellowship period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Encouraged fields of study
rubrics_metrics.description: Applications are encouraged from students in engineering and the physical, computer, mathematical or life sciences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: During the fellowship, research should be in areas of interest to the DOE.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligible applicant stages (measured at application)
rubrics_metrics.description: Eligibility is extended to undergraduate seniors; current master's degree students; first-year graduate students; employed individuals; and others, including those matriculating into graduate school.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Status is determined at the time of application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Master's students: institution change requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Current master's degree students MUST enroll at a different institution for Ph.D. studies to begin the fall term coincident with the start of DOE CSGF funding.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The uppercase 'MUST' indicates this is a strict condition for master's students receiving the award.

rubrics_metrics.name: Not eligible — second-year or beyond graduate students
rubrics_metrics.description: Second-year or beyond graduate students are not eligible for the DOE CSGF.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants who are already in their second year or later of graduate study should not apply.

rubrics_metrics.name: Not eligible — concurrent professional doctoral degrees
rubrics_metrics.description: Students pursuing a concurrent professional doctoral degree (e.g., dual enrollment as an M.D./Ph.D., J.D./Ph.D., D.V.M./Ph.D., etc.) are not eligible.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Concurrent professional/clinical doctorate programs disqualify applicants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Full-time enrollment requirement during fellowship
rubrics_metrics.description: During the fellowship period, fellows are required to be enrolled as full-time graduate students at an accredited U.S. college or university and conduct research in areas of interest to the DOE.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintaining full-time student status and DOE-relevant research is a condition of the award.

rubrics_metrics.name: Summer activity requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: The summer should be spent conducting full-time research related to the completion of one's degree program, enrolled in classes, or on a practicum assignment at a DOE facility.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Summer activities should contribute to degree progress or be a DOE practicum; routine unrelated summer work is not described as acceptable.

rubrics_metrics.name: TA Policy — limit on teaching duties
rubrics_metrics.description: The fellow’s department must waive any teaching requirements beyond one term.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program support is intended to allow focus on research; review the program's TA Policy for details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fellowship duration and renewal
rubrics_metrics.description: The fellowship provides four years of support but must be renewed annually.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Annual renewal is required to continue receiving support year-to-year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Annual renewal — acceptable academic performance
rubrics_metrics.description: Fellows must renew their appointment each year by submitting an online application that demonstrates their academic performance is acceptable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Acceptable academic performance is a renewal condition; documentation is submitted via the program's online renewal application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Annual renewal — progress in approved program of study coursework
rubrics_metrics.description: Renewal requires demonstrating that the fellow is progressing toward completing approved program of study coursework.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Progress toward degree-related coursework is evaluated annually as part of renewal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Annual renewal — completion of laboratory practicum experience
rubrics_metrics.description: Fellows must demonstrate they have completed a laboratory practicum experience as part of the annual renewal requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Completion of a laboratory practicum is explicitly listed as a renewal criterion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Annual renewal — conducting DOE-relevant research
rubrics_metrics.description: Renewal requires demonstrating the fellow is conducting research in fields of study relevant to the DOE.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Research relevance to DOE priorities is part of the annual assessment for continued funding.

rubrics_metrics.name: Award length may vary with fellow status and expected funding
rubrics_metrics.description: The fellow's status and the expected funding amount can affect the award's length.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Variations in status or funding projections may modify how long the award continues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prior approval required for additional graduate responsibilities
rubrics_metrics.description: The Krell Institute must approve in advance additional graduate responsibilities, such as a teaching assistantship.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Any additional duties that could affect fellowship obligations or time-to-degree require prior program approval.

rubrics_metrics.name: Permissible outside payments
rubrics_metrics.description: Fellows may accept scholarships, prizes and other payments (including veteran’s benefits) that do not require a service.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: External awards or benefits that carry a service requirement are not permitted; non-service payments are allowed.
